statuses.IMPLEMENTED: runs on real repository data and is covered by tests
statuses.IMPLEMENTED_HEURISTIC: runs and is tested, but is a transparent rule/linear method, not a learned model
statuses.PREPARED_UNVERIFIED: integration code exists but could not be executed in the build environment
statuses.EXTENSION_POINT: interface only; no model exists, no predictions are produced
statuses.BLOCKED_BY_DATA: cannot be built honestly until the listed labelled data exists

capabilities.name: U-Net baseline
capabilities.evidence: ml/baseline/BASELINE_v1.json; NumPy re-run matches stored PyTorch output (max |diff| 8.8e-8); fresh held-out evaluation ml/results/eval_baseline.json reproduces the stored historic-protocol metrics exactly and adds IoU, precision, recall, false-positive rate, calibration and leakage checks; real inference on the 2018-09-26 scene: ml/inference/run_unet_scene.py

capabilities.name: U-Net++ / DeepLabV3+ / SegFormer ensemble
capabilities.evidence: ml/extensions/interfaces.py SegmentationEnsemble (mean + disagreement combiner, tested with stub members)
capabilities.blocker: no trained members; needs the labelled dataset and GPU training; members must beat the baseline on the same 7 test scenes

capabilities.name: Self-supervised SAR encoder
capabilities.blocker: needs a large unlabelled Sentinel-1 corpus and GPU pre-training; only 3 SAR rasters are in the repository

capabilities.name: SAR look-alike classifier
capabilities.blocker: needs patches labelled oil vs named look-alike classes (low wind, biogenic, rain, wake); the dataset CSV 'class' column semantics are undocumented. Current behaviour: low-wind flag only (H2 hypothesis).

capabilities.name: Physics-informed / learned drift correction
capabilities.blocker: needs observed drifter/slick trajectories for held-out validation; the Lagrangian model stays authoritative until a candidate passes the gate

capabilities.name: Spatio-temporal Transformer / Neural Operator
capabilities.blocker: no training corpus: one hourly HYCOM analysis subset exists for one event (scripts/fetch_hycom_currents.py) and ERA5 covers 2 hours

capabilities.name: Spatio-temporal trajectory model
capabilities.blocker: one day of AIS (13,104 reports, 87 vessels) is far too little; needs months of AIS plus labelled behaviour

capabilities.name: Vessel relationship GNN
capabilities.blocker: no port/route/encounter graph data and no labels; the evidence graph is rule-built

capabilities.name: Cross-attention multimodal fusion
capabilities.blocker: needs many incidents with confirmed polluters; one real incident exists

capabilities.name: Probabilistic (calibrated) attribution model
capabilities.blocker: needs incidents with legally confirmed sources to calibrate P(compatible | evidence)

capabilities.name: SHAP-compatible explanations
capabilities.evidence: exact Shapley values of the linear composite (server/lib/attribution.ts; additivity tested)

capabilities.name: Probabilistic / Bayesian segmentation uncertainty
capabilities.blocker: the baseline U-Net has no dropout layers (MC-dropout impossible without retraining); ensemble uncertainty needs >=2 trained members. Current: rule-based uncertainty components + drift ensembles.

capabilities.name: Historical surface-current field (HYCOM analysis)
capabilities.evidence: scripts/fetch_hycom_currents.py writes data/currents/GOM_S1A_20180926_REAL_currents.json (HYCOM+NCODA GOMl0.04/expt_32.5, hourly, 1/25 deg, surface; a data-assimilative model analysis, NOT observations and NOT Copernicus Marine). Loaded by server/lib/environment.ts with land/no-data cells kept as null (never filled); covered by server/tests/engine.test.ts and agents.test.ts. Only the 2018-09-26 event has a current field.

capabilities.name: LangGraph orchestration
capabilities.evidence: server/lib/investigation.ts executeWithLangGraph runs every AEGIS node inside a real @langchain/langgraph StateGraph (default AEGIS_ORCHESTRATOR=auto). Verified: server/tests/agents.test.ts 'default (auto) runs the REAL @langchain/langgraph StateGraph' (12 node invocations by the LangGraph runtime, results identical to the fallback) and a production-bundle run (orchestrator_status LANGGRAPH, @langchain/langgraph 1.4.16). Nodes are rule-based computations: NO language model is used. When the package cannot load the run is labelled DETERMINISTIC_FALLBACK.

capabilities.name: Domain adaptation / continual learning
capabilities.blocker: needs labelled target-domain scenes (e.g. 2023-2026); unlabelled imagery is never used as ground truth

capabilities.name: Investigator feedback + review queue
capabilities.evidence: server/lib/review.ts (rule-based priority, feedback records marked UNVERIFIED_INVESTIGATOR_INPUT); ml/extensions/interfaces.py ActiveLearningQueue
capabilities.blocker: no retraining loop until the data protocol is verified

capabilities.name: Multi-satellite cross-validation
capabilities.blocker: only Sentinel-1 data exists in the repository
